name: Files and Folders
description: A custom hierarchical file/folder management system (node-based) with folder tree, uploads, thumbnails, and role-based folder access.
project_description:
Développement is in process. Somes features didn't work as expect for the moment

 All Files and Folders are created as nodes .

 

 

 Introduction 
 

 It allows users to organize, browse, and manage files and folders in a hierarchical structure, similar to a traditional file explorer. 

 

 

 Features 
 

Hierarchical file and folder structure

Separate content types for files and folders

Multiple layouts available, list grids, etc

Admin can create folders with image.

Thumbnails are generated for various format.

Files could be open in interface with viewers inttegred.

File metadata storage (type, size, etc.)

Dedicated forms for file and folder creation/editing

Fine-grained access control

Twig integration for customizable display

 After installing the Files and Folders module:

 Place the block files and folders with layout builder and ENJOY 

Use the 'Add files' or 'Add folder' buttons to start organizing your content.

 

 

 Similar projects 
 

File (Drupal core): Basic file handling

File Browser: Provides a file browser interface

File Manager: Another file management solution

Files and Folders differentiates itself by offering a more intuitive, hierarchical structure and granular visibility controls.
